purpose: Persistent, dynamic work queue for the BusinessForge autonomous execution mandate (section 5). Source of truth for what is queued, in progress, done, blocked. Read this file before starting a new work session; append/update rather than replace when possible; recompute after every meaningful completion per the mandate's continuous-execution loop (section 4).

taskSchema.priority: P0 (blocks the product) | P1 (high leverage) | P2 (normal) | P3 (cosmetic/low)
taskSchema.dependencies: array of task ids that must be DONE first, or []
taskSchema.assignedWorker: which capability/model/deterministic-code would execute this, per lib/capability/orchestrator.ts's plan() where applicable
taskSchema.attempts: integer, incremented on each real attempt
taskSchema.outputs: what this task is expected to produce
taskSchema.validationState: UNVERIFIED | TYPECHECKED | TESTED_LOCAL | TESTED_NATIVE | LIVE_VERIFIED — never claim more than what actually ran
taskSchema.failureState: null, or a short machine-readable reason when status is FAILED/BLOCKED_HUMAN
taskSchema.costUnits: rough estimate in €cents or 'free' — see lib/capability's cost model; omitted when genuinely unknown
